rv.q: Nonetheless, its dynamically joyous score and gripping theme create a unique concert experience audiences will enjoy.
Hundred Days has music that fills the soul, yet deserves a refined vision that places the audience closer to the action.
The self-described folk-punk score is the standout feature of married couple Abigail and Shaun Bengson’s autobiographical odyssey into their love story and life leading their family band.
In the dark days of October, Hundred Days provides a welcome dose of comfort and joy. It's just plain wonderful.
